schedule_owner.rule: Resolve the actual production US/KR market-message execution cutoff from repository scheduler/config before choosing a source-finality strategy.

allowed_proof: explicit provider field documented as regular-session settled close for the owned session
historical/daily endpoint whose documented row semantics prove completed daily close
already-approved read-only route that exposes previous/regular close with exact session ownership
not_allowed: current quote silently treated as close
using a later row that would not exist at the actual production cutoff

kr_sector.post_close_mode: Current-only sector snapshot may own the completed same-day session only with exchange CLOSED state + provider semantics + completed composite-index parity proof.
kr_sector.pre_close_mode: Previous completed-session ranking requires an approved target-date historical sector route.

macro_display.direction_evidence: only CURRENT_BY_PROVIDER_CALENDAR or otherwise source-owned current rows
macro_display.latest_available_information: may render in a clearly separated/delayed informational block with observation date; must never become current-direction support/contradiction
